metadata.restatement_note: Restatement 2026-11-18 (Audit §86.5 Ruling 1, §86.6, criteria 1.1.10): supersedes the §79 restatement recorded below. Criteria 1.1.10 changes no numeric threshold and no criterion. It corrects the 2019 calendar grid by restoring Tuesday 2019-10-29 as a regular session (2019: 244 -> 245; total 2935 -> 2936; warm-up window 2018-04-01..2021-12-31 930 -> 931), reseals expected_calendar_fingerprint to the recomputed CAL-FPR, and reseals the manifest pin after the seven 2018-2021 A1 circular artifacts are registered. The corrected date is pre-binding, so no row on this bundle is computed differently and the verdict is unchanged. Restatement 2026-11-17 (Audit §79.12 items 2, 4 and 5, criteria 1.1.9): supersedes the §78.11 restatement recorded below. Criteria version 1.1.9 changes no numeric threshold and no criterion; it reseals expected_manifest_fingerprint because TATASTEEL's ISIN_TRANSITION is now dated 2022-07-29, the successor ISIN's first session (N-158), and it closes two bypasses the §79 round measured — CRIT-OVERFIT-06 is NOT RUN when a positive fold ratio arrives without a valid integer walk_forward_validation_folds_count (N-156), and CRIT-STAT-01 is NOT RUN when total_trades and liquidated_open_positions arrive without closed_only_trade_count (N-159); neither repair changes a row on this Tier-A bundle, which carries neither a fold ratio nor a total_trades count. Under 1.1.8, the §78.11 restatement supersedes the §77.15 items 1-6 restatement recorded below, the §76.16 items 1-6 restatement recorded above, the 1.1.5 restatement recorded under Audit §75.10 items 3-4, the 1.1.4 restatement recorded under §74.10 Ruling D, the 1.1.3 one under §73.9 items 3-4, the 1.1.2 one under §72 N-128, the 1.1.1 one under §68.6 item 3 (H-115), and the 2026-11-14T16:45:00+00:00 artifact before those. Criteria version 1.1.8 changes no numeric threshold and no criterion. It reseals expected_manifest_fingerprint because the ISIN_TRANSITION table is now generated for every multi-ISIN symbol the committed interval table records rather than for the fourteen a dataset happened to visit (§78.11, N-151), and it closes three bypasses the §78 audit measured: CRIT-STAT-01 is NOT RUN when total_trades arrives without liquidated positions or a declared liquidated count (N-148); CRIT-OVERFIT-03 pins the four pre-registered anchored fold ends and refuses a self-declared ratio with no fold rows (N-149); CRIT-OVERFIT-06 is NOT RUN below 2 validation folds whatever ratio is supplied (N-150). No row on this Tier-A bundle is computed differently by those three repairs, because it carries none of the evidence they refuse. Under 1.1.7, no numeric PASS/FAIL threshold moved. It (i) adds CRIT-OVERFIT-05, min_liquidated_pf_ex_top_1 = 1.40, so a liquidated PF that needs its single largest winner to clear 1.50 is a FAIL rather than a sentence beside the row (§77.12 item 4); and (ii) re-points CRIT-OVERFIT-03 at the anchored expanding in-sample folds — four partitions of one run's own ledger ending 2022-06-30, 2022-12-30, 2023-06-30 and 2023-12-29, gated by min_positive_is_fold_ratio = 0.75 and min_fold_liquidated_pf = 1.30 — with the previous validation-fold definition moving unchanged to CRIT-OVERFIT-06, so min_positive_walk_forward_fold_ratio = 0.80 stays enforced (§77.13). Both new rows are NOT RUN on this Tier-A bundle, which carries no trade ledger to partition. This artifact also stops reporting an archive-wide bhavcopy resolution under CRIT-DATA-05's key: that statistic now travels as archive_traded_eq_resolution_pct, because CRIT-DATA-05 is the evaluation window's traded-row measure and the two denominators are not interchangeable (§77.15 item 2, N-146). Under 1.1.6 it (i) excluded expected_trial_registry_manifest_sha256 from the criteria fingerprint, so appending a trial and re-pinning the manifest no longer invalidates the anchor a verdict cites, while the pin stays mandatory in the loader and is still enforced by Gate G2A-6.8a (N-139); (ii) gates min_haircut_sharpe_ratio = 1.25 as CRIT-OVERFIT-04 instead of leaving a committed threshold unenforced (N-141); (iii) evaluates CRIT-STAT-01 and CRIT-STAT-02 on the liquidated book, with the closed-only pair and the PF sensitivity to the largest winners retained as disclosures on the same rows (Ruling 1); (iv) evaluates CRIT-STAT-03 at trade entry, as its own definition says, with the hold-period maximum reported and not gated (Ruling 2); (v) wires CRIT-DATA-05 to the H-54 traded-row measure and adds CRIT-DATA-07 dataset completeness at 100.0%, so 196 / 211 = 92.8910% fails closed until the 15 unresolved instruments are accounted for (Ruling 3, N-140); and (vi) attributes every ticket rejection by side and reason, so a refused SELL is visible (N-142). The trials manifest pin is unchanged at 3326b1b2... with N = 9, N_eval = 5, and no trial was appended or scored in this commit. Provenance remains CONTENT_IDENTIFIED_ONLY / SOURCE_UNVERIFIED, so CRIT-PROV-01 is still NOT RUN and every Tier-A verdict is unchanged.
